scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; ua="${npm_config_user_agent:-}"; ep="${npm_execpath:-}"; case "$ua $ep" in *pnpm/*|*pnpm.mjs*|*pnpm.cjs*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
